crossRefs.note: It is well with the man who deals graciously and lends. He will maintain his cause in judgment.
Then the presidents and the local governors sought to find occasion against Daniel as touching the kingdom; but they…
Then these men said, “We won’t find any occasion against this Daniel, unless we find it against him concerning the law…
Walk in wisdom toward those who are outside, redeeming the time.
But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach, and it will be…
But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceful, gentle, reasonable, full of mercy and good fruits…

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: When Saul saw that he behaved himself very wisely, he stood in awe of him.
translations.bsb: When Saul saw that David was very successful, he was afraid of him.
translations.kjv: Wherefore when Saul saw that he behaved ➔ himself very wisely, he was afraid of him.
translations.asv: And when Saul saw that he behaved himself very wisely, he stood in awe of him.
